products.name: YITAMOTOR Radiator Compatible with 2003-2009 4Runner, Fit for 2007-2014 Toyota FJ Cruiser 4.0L V6
products.fitment:
2003 - 2009 Toyota 4Runner 4.0L V6 Only (Not for 4.7L V8)
2007 - 2014 Toyota FJ Cruiser 4.0L V6
products.description:
The radiator is a vital component of a vehicle’s cooling system, which helps to remove the heat from the engine and keep your car running smoothly and safely at peak performance. YITAMOTOR radiator is constructed using high density multi-louvered aluminum fins to ensure better cooling efficiency and thus improve your vehicle’s performance. Besides, advanced PA66 tanks have excellent high temperature resistance & pass leak testing for added durability of long use. All radiators are designed to meet or exceed OE standard for fit, form and function.
Fitment
2003 - 2009 Toyota 4Runner 4.0L V6 Only (Not for 4.7L V8)
2007 - 2014 Toyota FJ Cruiser 4.0L V6
Features
COMPATIBILITY: YITAMOTOR OE radiator is compatible with 2003 2004 2005 2006 2007 2008 2009 4Runner, fit for 2007 2008 2009 2010 2011 2012 2013 2014 FJ Cruiser 4.0L V6, please check carefully the compatibility before purchase(Radiator Cap Not Included).
DIMENSION: Core Size: 25.6"x23.1", Header Size: 24.4"x 1.9". OE design makes it fit for your vehicle and easy to replace with clear installation instruction.
HIGH COOLING EFFICIENCY: The core of this radiator is built with high density aluminum tubes and fins which has a larger radiation area for maximum heat dissipation and stronger rigidity for added durability; Aluminum oil cooler also achieves the optimal cooling effect to ensure the engine works properly.
LEAKPROOF & ANTI-CRACK: Seamlessly welded with high glass fiber reinforced nylon PA66 outlet/inlet tanks, featuring better heat against extreme engine temperature. No more crack or leak worries!
RELIABLE & WELL-PACKAGED: All our radiators are leak-tested & well-protected with PE foam & multi-layered cardboard to ensure a snug and solid packaging. Professional installation would be highly recommended.
Note
The radiator cap that has not passed the test can’t release the pressure when it reaches the pressure value.
The damaged thermostat is unable to carry out a large cycle, resulting in a continuous increase in the radiator pressure.
The radiator fan does not turn, resulting in high temperature in the water tank.
Drain the air from the cooling system. Refer to the user manual or repair manual.
Please refer to owner's manual to add coolant.
Do not open the hood until the steam has subsided. The engine compartment may be very hot, causing serious injuries such as burns.
Please stop the vehicle immediately, when “ENGINE OVERHEAT/High Temperature” shows on the dashboard or steam comes out from under the hood.
Keep hands and clothing (especially a tie, a scarf) away from the fans and belts. Failure to do so may cause the hands or clothing to be caught, resulting in serious injuries.
Do not loosen the radiator cap while the engine and radiator are hot. Serious injuries, such as burns, may result from hot coolant and steam released under pressure.
